prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
No kind of change can be called helpful yet, as no tests have won.
'adoption, new_flow' changes have shown no clear effect across 3 tests.
'sign_in, redesign' changes have shown negative results after noise correction across 2 tests.
Evidence is still thin for 'adoption, redesign', 'finish, new_screen', 'finish, redesign', and 'sign_in, reorder' changes, as their tests either lack a second trial or disagree on effect.
Predictions have mostly been too high compared to noise-corrected measurements, though rounds 7, 8, and 9 were underestimated.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: -0.6% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: +3.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -0.5% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- finish, redesign: -2.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, redesign: -3.6% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: -6.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_screen] adoption_care_pledge_screen: Add a new interactive pet care commitment screen right after adoption certificate where users sign a promise to care for their pet. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion in the funnel (60.9%) and long completion times (mean 1017s); a pledge screen deepens emotional bond and provides clear closure.)
1: [finish, new_screen] finish_desktop_interaction_demo_screen: Add a dedicated interactive demo screen at the finish step showing how to click, drag, and hide the pet on desktop. (why: Multiple support emails (3 complaints) reported confusion about how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after completing setup.)
2: [home, wait_info] waiting_progress_tip_timer: Enable visual progress bars, time estimates, and auto-advancing pet tips on the waiting screen. (why: The waiting screen has a huge mean completion time of 2336s (median 201s) and loses 18.7% of users who get tired of waiting without feedback.)
3: [finish, copy] home_intro_desktop_visibility_copy: Update home_intro text to clearly explain desktop pet placement and system tray controls. (why: Support receives tickets about pets not appearing on desktop or users not knowing how to control them.)
4: [sign_in, notification] sign_in_existing_account_notify: Add an explicit warning and hint for returning users to log in with their original auth method to prevent duplicate accounts. (why: The single largest support theme (8 emails) is pets missing or reset after signing in with a different/new account.)
5: [adoption, redesign] pick_friend_grid_layout_redesign: Redesign pick_friend screen using a multi-column grid layout to showcase all starter companions at once. (why: Adoption has a 60.9% conversion rate and mean time of 1017s; browsing pets needs to be faster and clearer.)
6: [choose_path, new_flow] story_onboarding_intro_flow: Insert a welcoming introductory screen before path selection explaining what a desktop pet is. (why: 23.8% dropoff on choose_path indicates users need context before choosing how to create their pet.)
7: [home, layout] waiting_stage_card_layout: Reformat waiting screen to a stage layout featuring animated pet creation status. (why: Home waiting screen drops 18.7% of users and takes median 201s / mean 2336s.)
